messages:
Priya (Eng Manager): Hey @Alex — starting Lena next Monday. Can you drop a compact first-week agenda and a concrete 30/60/90 we can review? Want something I can share with the team and copy into her offer paperwork.

Alex (People Ops): Yup! Drafting now. Quick Q: do you want a role-specific 30/60/90 (runtime infra focus) or a generic eng one?

Priya (Eng Manager): Role-specific please — runtime + serving basics, plus one measurable deliverable.

Alex (People Ops): Got it. Posting a short plan below — copy/paste friendly. Also assigning Cameron as buddy unless you prefer someone else.

Alex (People Ops):
```
First-week agenda (overview):
Day 0 (pre-start): IT ship, 1Password invite, workspace access, invite to #eng and #eng-runtime
Day 1: Welcome all-hands (30m), team intros (30m), product & infra 101 (1h), laptop setup walkthrough
Day 2: Local dev env + repo sync (pair with buddy), access review (DB, GCS, model store)
Day 3: Small onboarding ticket (first-timers label) + shadow pairing on a runtime bug
Day 4: Deep dive: serving architecture (45m) + logging/tracing overview (30m)
Day 5: 1:1 recap, goal-setting for 30/60/90, schedule 30-day retro

Manager checklist (week 1):
- Add Lena to recurring team meetings and calendar blocks (include 2x "focus" windows)
- Send intro post in #general and #eng-runtime with a short bio
- Confirm buddy assigned and first pairing slot booked
- Ensure SSO/MFA and KMS access done day 0
- Create first onboarding issue and label it "first-timers"

30/60/90 (runtime eng, copyable):
- 30 days: Finish dev env, submit first PR that fixes a small infra bug or doc gap, attend model-serving design review, complete Security Foundations training
- 60 days: Own a small component (e.g., KV cache cleanup or batching config), reduce an onboarding doc gap, add one metric to the console dashboard, complete prod incident runbook draft
- 90 days: Lead rollout of a minor optimization to reduce median token latency or cost for a route, be primary on an oncall rotation, present a proposal for a performance or cost improvement
```

Alex (People Ops): Bonus items — add a "first 2 weeks" Kanban board in the onboarding repo and tag PR reviewers in advance.

Priya (Eng Manager): Love it. Cameron is fine as buddy. Can you also schedule the 30-day retro and a 1:1 cadence (weekly for first 6 weeks)?

Alex (People Ops): Done — weekly 1:1s are in. I scheduled 30-day retro for Friday (week 2) 10:00AM.

OnboardingBot: Reminder: Security Foundations and Data Handling courses will DM Lena on day 1 and day 8. Completion target: basic by EOD day 3, full by day 14.

Lena (New Hire): Quick q — laptop still shows "label created" in tracking. ETA? Also where do I find the "first-timers" issues?

IT Support: Hi @Lena — carrier delay on pickup, ETA 48 hours. Please DM your preferred delivery time if you need it sooner. First-timers issues: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/first-timers (link also in #eng-runtime pin).

Cameron (Buddy): I'll ping you tomorrow and we'll do a 1:1 to walk through repo layout and local setup. Also, I'll add a starter checklist in the onboarding board with two safe PRs to pick from.

HR Ops: Heads up — please confirm Lena's preferred pronouns and a short bio for intro post. Also, add a 30-minute benefits orientation in week 1.

Priya (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone. I'll prep the role-specific first PR with an easy changelist. Alex — can you drop the copyable intro blurb (one-liner + fun fact) in this thread so I can post?

Alex (People Ops): Sure — pulling one now: "Lena joins as a Runtime Engineer focusing on serving optimizations. Previously worked on distributed systems at BrightCloud. Fun fact: avid rock climber. Welcome Lena! :wave:"

Lena (New Hire): Thanks — confirmed pronouns and bio sent to @HR Ops. Appreciate the warm welcome. Looking forward to week 1! :smile:

Priya (Eng Manager): Perfect. See you Monday. I'll post the intro after Alex's blurb.

Alex (People Ops): Posted intro in #general and pinned starter links in #eng-runtime. If hardware or access blocks come up, mention @IT Support and include ticket tag "onboarding-urgent".

Lena (New Hire): One more — who do I ask about Dedicated GPU access for experiments?

Priya (Eng Manager): Raise an eng-infra ticket and CC me. We'll fast-track a dev quota for the first 30 days.

IT Support: Noted — CC'd on infra ticket request.

Alex (People Ops): Closing checklist item: send fillable 30/60/90 doc to Priya and Lena (done). I'll follow up if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
